canonicalInstructionsUnchanged: Set a barbell in a rack near shoulder height. Take a grip just outside shoulder width, brace the trunk, and step back with the bar at the front of the shoulders.
Press overhead while keeping the ribs down and moving the head just enough to let the bar pass.
Lower to the front of the shoulders without leaning back, then return the bar to the rack after the set.
rationale: The first Graphic 3D motion shows a return and quiet finish, but its far elbow stays bent at maximum height. Establish and review an explicit overhead endpoint before another paid motion attempt. The cycle intentionally begins overhead so the missing endpoint can anchor both ends.

referenceInspection.observation: Far elbow remains visibly bent throughout the dense 2.0–3.6 second top-phase sequence. A trim cannot supply the missing clear extended endpoint.

motionProposal.title: Graphic 3D · Lower and press cycle
motionProposal.caption: Starts overhead. Lower to the front shoulders under control, then press back to the same overhead position. Follow Form for rack setup and the initial press.
motionProposal.alt: Overhead Press lower and press cycle: starts with the bar overhead, lowers to the front shoulders, then presses back to the same overhead endpoint.
motionProposal.teachingCoverage: One lowering and pressing cycle beginning overhead. Canonical Form retains the rack setup, shoulder-height starting posture, press and reracking instructions.
